ex.s: If praise is sincere and focused on the effort not the outcome, you can give it as often as your child does something that deserves a verbal reward." ex.t: “如果赞扬是真诚且关注努力而非结果，你就可以在孩子做出值得口头奖励的事时随时给予。”我们应该特别认可孩子们推动自己、努力达成目标的付出，”《不带恐惧育儿》的作者Donahue说。

ex.s: Praising the effort and not the outcome can also mean recognizing your child when she has worked hard to clean the yard, cook dinner, or finish a book report.
ex.t: 赞扬努力而非结果也意味着，当你的孩子在打扫院子、做晚饭或完成读书报告上付出努力时，认可她。

ex.s: When I was 17， I read a magazine article about a museum called the McNay， once the home of a watercolorist named Marian McNay． She had requested the community to turn it into a museum upon her death． On a sunny Saturday， Sally and I drove over to the museum． She asked， "Do you have the address？ ""No， but I'll recognize it， there was a picture in the magazine．
ex.t: 17岁时，我读到一篇杂志文章，介绍一家叫McNay的博物馆，它曾是一位叫Marian McNay的水彩画家的家。她曾请求社区在她去世后把它改成博物馆。一个阳光明媚的周六，Sally和我开车去了博物馆。她问：“你有地址吗？”“没有，但我会认出它，杂志上有一张照片。”
